lead.t: The edinger-westphal nucleus of the midbrain is activated by visual stimuli, which sends signals through the oculomotor nerve (cranial nerve III).

snip.t: The edinger-westphal nucleus of the midbrain is activated by visual stimuli, which sends signals through the oculomotor nerve (cranial nerve III).
Increased intracranial pressure (ICP) also produces oculomotor nerve palsy because of the presence of temporal lobe compression of the nerve during tentorial herniation.
Uncal herniation compresses the oculomotor nerve → fixed dilated pupil.
